scope: Documented claims and proposed implications, not runtime results

facts.claim: Planner FAQ states up to four simultaneously launched UAVs.
facts.scope: Described Planner configuration; not a solver or TZ fleet-size limit

facts.claim: Planner FAQ limits support to Geoscan aircraft.
facts.scope: No assumed ArduPilot or MAVLink interoperability

facts.claim: Planner release notes document mission export to KML.
facts.scope: Export existence does not prove full semantic round-trip

facts.claim: Current automatic mission execution and import path on 801 are not established by the stale Q4 2025 FAQ promise.
facts.scope: Must obtain target firmware and a working reference mission

facts.claim: 801 aircraft and remote firmware must be updated as a compatible pair.
801 FAQ does not provide third-party basemap file support, unlike desktop Planner.
Gemini firmware 10404 and 10438 are marked service-center-only updates.
facts.scope: Do not schedule self-service upgrade as a hackathon dependency

facts.claim: Gemini speed in release 7070 is dynamic with wind, height and photo spacing, with a stated maximum of 15 m/s.
facts.scope: Not a guaranteed speed for every payload or flight

facts.claim: Magnetic service describes 10 Hz observation records, while the sensor table separately states 1000 Hz.
facts.scope: Different sampling layers; do not substitute one for the other

facts.claim: Magnetic service describes control measurements on at least 5 percent of survey routes.
facts.scope: Count of routes as worded on site; not automatically a TZ requirement

facts.claim: A magnetic planning profile needs sensor altitude and payload constraints separate from aircraft center altitude.
facts.scope: Payload length and dynamic tolerances remain unknown

facts.claim: Copter Planner manual describes 5/3/0.5 m/s landing phases with thresholds 50 and 25 m.
facts.scope: Gemini/401 manual profile, not 801; barometric caveat applies

facts.claim: Cloud inspection photo filtering does not account for occluding objects or depth maps.
facts.scope: Projected footprint is not verified line of sight

facts.claim: Cloud viewer documentation excludes geoid height transformations and local DEM in comparison mode.
Cloud documentation supports GeoJSON vectors and describes .3tz export of point/tiled data in EPSG:4978.
facts.scope: Keep geocentric coordinates distinct from EPSG:4326 longitude/latitude

facts.claim: The public cloud integration API contract is not established by API host settings in Metashape.
facts.scope: No unauthorised or speculative API integration

facts.claim: 801 logs from the remote and autopilot are separate exports.
facts.scope: Record provenance and clock alignment; no logs collected from hardware

facts.claim: UI metrics and proof artifacts must be invalidated after geometry or profile edits, independently of visual LOD.
facts.scope: Proposed product behavior, not an implemented feature
